summary: 2026-11-27 to 11-28: 2 framework updates recorded, 0 LLM updates. (1) Ollama v0.40.19 FORMALLY RELEASED (2026-11-26T17:52Z; the v0.40.19-rc0 prerelease noted yesterday became formal) - Inkling 2 faster short histories, draft proposals and conversation snapshots (PR #19881), mlxrunner compact Engram history buffers reducing Apple MLX-path memory (PR #19913), bundled llama-server bump (PR #19917, target build not stated in release body); no speed multipliers published. (2) llama.cpp dev builds continued b12791 -> b12818 (27 commits, compare b12791...b12818): ggml quant-scale support for FP8 and NVFP4 incl. per-tensor/per-channel/per-expert scales and activation scales in mul_mat/mul_mat_id (PR #28898, in b12818), CUDA+HIP Flash Attention with indexed bias (PR #33063), moe-cache support for experts selected on another backend (PR #33133), recurrent states read in place instead of copying (PR #28841/#30139), CUDA fusion of Inkling 2 short conv/depth mix/loop controller/L2 clip/situ chains (PR #33060), BailingMoE3 ssm_conv+silu fusion (PR #33081), OpenCL MoE int8 bin kernel for Adreno A850 (PR #33069) and multi-token f32 GEMV for speculative verify (PR #33098), Vulkan FA compact bias for Inkling 2 Mini (PR #32898), SYCL FA vector kernel routing for BMG D=256 decode (PR #30606); no speed multipliers published, formal release remains v1.1.0. No other new formal framework release in window: vLLM v0.34.0, SGLang v0.5.23, TensorRT-LLM v1.3.0 (v1.4.0rc4 remains prerelease), LMDeploy v0.18.0, vLLM-Omni v0.34.0, MLX v0.32.5, LightLLM v1.2.0, ExLlamaV2 v0.3.2, DeepSpeed v0.20.1, ROCm rocm-7.14.0 remain latest (GitHub releases API checked for all). All LLM series (Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Llama, Mistral, GLM, Kimi, MiniMax, Phi, Nemotron, GPT, Claude, Gemini, Grok, Liquid, StepFun, MiniCPM): no primary-confirmed important updates in window; HF org pages checked via API (latest modifications are pre-window or out of scope: google/timesfm-3.0 is a time-series model outside the tracked LLM series, nvidia Nemotron rerank checkpoints were already noted as out of scope yesterday). Secondary calendars listing a Nov 27 Ant Group 'Ling 3.2 Flash' catalogue entry had no primary announcement or official checkpoint confirmation, so it was not recorded. Direct-apply per skill section 9 (Phase 1).
